Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Time, the calendar & feasts

short adjective

in time

also brief, a short time, for a short while, shortly, be brief

classical

Cic. Amic. 104
Hor. Ars 335

brevis, breve

adjective, third declension

short, brief

Short in time and brief in speech (brevis esse, “to be brief”). Brevī is “shortly, soon”, and breviter “briefly”.

Examples

  • omnia autem brevia tolerābilia esse dēbent, etiamsī magna sunt

    anything short ought to be bearable, even if it is greatCic. Amic. 104

  • quidquid praecipiēs, estō brevis

    whatever you teach, be briefHor. Ars 335

  • Brevī redībō.

    I’ll be back shortly.composed

See also short, long, a little later.

SourcesLewis & Short: brevis

Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-cicero-philosophica, loci-horatius), checked against the editions named there.

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
